limitations: Adapted current hourly descriptive analysis, not execution of historical cutoff-bound #2 CLI.
Binance minute/hour reconciliation audits available last16 complete hours only; z history uses API completed hourly bars.
HYPE spot taker direction not provided by Bybit/HL candles. Never impute missing spot flow from perp.
Signed taker volume is aggressor imbalance, not capital inflow. OI cannot distinguish opening-long/short or covering.
Book snapshots and hourly closes have different timestamps. Crossvenue hourly basis uses synchronized closes only.

latest_quotes.note: Latest quote check; different timestamp from completed hourly metrics. Not a completed hourly signal.

regime.scope: descriptive metrics only; no directional forecast, strategy, win rate, or predictive-edge claim

research_anchor.scope: Current descriptive public-data only. No source DB or sealed research modifications.
research_anchor.transport: HTTPS through local allowlisted proxy, IPv4 and DNS bound to ExpressVPN eth1; no fallback

method_notes.daily_regime: 90-day close trend; 30-day annualized log-return realized volatility; shifted prior 730-day median threshold with minimum 252 prior estimates
method_notes.horizon_scale: sqrt-time values are return-volatility scales, not prediction/confidence bands
method_notes.data_quality: only contiguous completed candle runs are used; gaps and unavailable measures remain null

historical_long_path_risk.method: non-overlapping completed hourly long-entry intervals; descriptive path excursions, not a strategy

cross_asset_30d.method: each observation uses the same explicit start and end close dates for both assets. For an index pair, adjacent native index trading dates define intervals; crypto must have UTC daily closes on those exact dates. No weekend/holiday forward fill. Crypto UTC close and equity local-market close remain asynchronous.
